visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A sleek black cat lies on its back atop a beige, plush cushion resting on a light-colored wooden floor. A human hand with manicured nails gently brushes the cat's belly. In the background, vertical light-wood panels form a clean interior wall under bright, even lighting. (2) A woman with long, straight black hair enters the frame from the top, burying her face into the cat's soft black fur to nuzzle it. The cat remains still, its green eyes wide open and its small pink tongue momentarily visible, appearing startled yet passive. (3) The camera remains steady as the woman continues to nuzzle the cat's belly. The cat's expression is frozen in a humorous, wide-eyed stare while the woman's hair spills over its body. The focus is sharp on the cat's face and paws. (4) The scene shifts to a tighter close-up of the cat's face, capturing its dilated pupils and slightly confused look. Finally, the cat resumes its grooming routine by licking its front paw, completely ignoring the woman who is still leaning over it.
